Context: 4. Seniority of Surplus Staff and Re-deployment

4. 7.1. General Principles of Seniority.In Central Services, the relative seniority of direct recruits is determined by the order of merit in which they are selected on the recommendation of the UPSC or other selecting authority. Those appointed through an earlier selection hold seniority over those appointed through a subsequent selection.
